tasks_completed.description: Implement PDF renderer (A4 portrait, CJK font, TOC, atomic write)
tasks_completed.rationale: Spec §5.11 A AC1 requires A4 PDF, one day per page, CJK font, TOC. Implementation uses reportlab Platypus with WenQuanYi Zen Hei (TTC subfontIndex=0) primary font, fc-match fallback for system discovery, STSong-Light CID as final degraded fallback. TOC links each day via internal anchors. PageBreak between days enforces 'one day per page'.

tasks_completed.description: Implement iCal renderer (VEVENT, VALARM, TZID, day-anchor fallback)
tasks_completed.rationale: Spec §5.11 + AC2 requires valid icalendar with TZID per event, VALARM 30min before, red-eye DTSTART on owning Day N (§5.13 B), and day-anchor fallback 09:00 Asia/Shanghai when slot has no explicit start_time. Implementation: per-slot tz-aware datetime via city_tz_for(); first untimed slot anchored at DEFAULT_DAY_ANCHOR (09:00) with +90min roll forward per codex Q2 guidance; segment events use depart_ts (or anchor) and inherit owning_day from common.segments_for_day.

tasks_completed.description: Implement PDF + iCal CLI entry points
tasks_completed.rationale: Spec AC3 mandates 'python3 scripts/export-{pdf,ical}.py --trip <id>' headless invocation with exit 0 on success. Both CLIs bootstrap sys.path, call load_trip_for_export() + export_{pdf,ical}(), print resolved path + byte size, return 1 with traceback on exception.

tasks_completed.description: Write fixture-driven exporter tests (8 tests, ≥3 fixture types)
tasks_completed.rationale: Spec AC9 requires ≥3 fixture tests covering Normal day, Red-eye day, missing-image fallback. Implemented 4 pytest fixtures (normal_trip, red_eye_trip, missing_image_trip, with_cached_image_trip) and 16 tests total: PDF magic header, atomic-write residue absence, red-eye owning-day verification, missing-image placeholder, CJK font registration, default vs explicit output paths, iCal validity via icalendar.Calendar.from_ical, VALARM presence with -30min trigger, day-anchor 09:00 fallback, +90min roll forward, transit-event DTSTART on Day 2 (depart_day), arrival-marker presence on Day N+1.

codex_consult.feedback_summary: Q1 (CJK font): pick (a) — registerFont(TTFont('CJK', '/usr/share/fonts/truetype/wqy/wqy-zenhei.ttc', subfontIndex=0)) primary; fc-match candidates secondary; UnicodeCIDFont('STSong-Light') last-resort. STSong-Light is NOT reliable as primary. Q2 (iCal day-anchor): pick (b) — first untimed slot at 09:00 Asia/Shanghai, roll subsequent untimed slots forward by SLOT_DEFAULT_DURATION_MIN (90min). Do NOT use SLOT_ANCHORS unconditionally because breakfast would start at 08:00 and violate the spec-mandated 09:00 fallback.
codex_consult.feedback_incorporated: Q1: ensure_cjk_font() implements the 3-tier fallback exactly as recommended (KNOWN_CJK_PATHS first → fc-match → STSong-Light). On this host the primary path succeeds (backend=ttf:/usr/share/fonts/truetype/wqy/wqy-zenhei.ttc). Q2: _fallback_slot_dt(slot_index, day) returns DEFAULT_DAY_ANCHOR (09:00) + slot_index * 90min. test_ical_day_anchor_fallback_09_00 + test_ical_roll_forward_90min lock this behavior. SLOT_ANCHORS dict is preserved in common.py for potential future use but is NOT consumed by the iCal renderer.
